device.name: eSpire290_OLP_CMS
device.notes: eSpire 290 battery-side system template, from OLP290_CMS_ETH2_V3.3-LY 20260930.xlsx + strategy doc V0.4 (R&D for C&I SharePoint: 020 Product/espire 290/EMS General/General). Connect on ETH2 192.168.2.101:503 (upper-level EMS interface). Addresses are the sheet's labels used as literal PDU addresses (e.g. IR 31962) - verify on first site connect, see docs/eSpire290_OLP_CMS_Modbus_Register_Map.md section 2. Per-cluster BMS (base 31981, stride 50) and per-TMU (base 33162, stride 28) telemetry live in the offset templates eSpire290_OLP_BMS_Cluster_ss_TEMPLATE / eSpire290_OLP_TMU_ss_TEMPLATE, instantiated by src/telemetry/espire290OlpCms.ts. Sign: CMS current/power are charge +, discharge -. PCS is the Delta PCS125HV - reuse Delta_280_ss40k.

telemetry.description: System SN length (chars, 0-24); SN chars follow at 30001-30024 as one ASCII char per register
Controller software version, v.nn.mm packed decimal
Default working mode (definition changed in V3.0)
Dry/wet inputs DI4-DI19 (bit0-15). DI4 = E-stop (NC, open = trip)
HSD outputs: bit0 green lamp, bit1 yellow (any HV on), bit2 red (severe alarm)
Rated capacity (kWh). Int16 x0.1 would overflow above 3276.7 kWh (~11 clusters) - read unsigned
Energy from current SOC to SOC upper limit (kWh)
Energy from current SOC to SOC lower limit (kWh)
Total current of HV-on clusters (A). Sign: charge +, discharge -

CMS fault word 1: b0 CMS fault, b1 BMS count cfg err, b2 cell capacity cfg err, b3 BSU count cfg err, b4 cell count cfg err, b5 TC count cfg err, b6 SOC diff too high, b7 SOC too low (<10%, blocks HV-on), b8 cell dV too high (>500 mV, blocks HV-on), b9 inter-cluster current too high (>10 A, blocks HV-on)
CMS fault word 2: b0 CMS emergency stop (HV off) - per strategy doc V0.4 only, not in point sheet
CMS warning word 1: b0 online BMS < configured, b4 SOC diff warning, b6 cell dV warning, b7 current diff warning
CMS warning word 4: bitN = BMS N+1 SOC too low
MIN(cluster allowed charge current) x HV-on cluster count (A)
MIN(cluster allowed discharge current) x HV-on cluster count (A)
DC power = cmsVoltage x cmsCurrent (kW). Sign: charge +, discharge - (opposite of PCS convention)
Insulation monitor: b0-3 state (1 self-check, 2 normal, 5 HV+ to ground fault, 6 HV- to ground fault), b4-5 fault level (00 normal, 01 level-2, 10 level-1)

commands.description: Working mode: 1 = plan, 3 = manual (vendor default 3: execute realtime power immediately). Moved from 40017 in V3.0
Operation mode: 1 = local (touch panel), 2 = remote (Modbus TCP on ETH2, vendor default). Moved from 40016 in V3.0
Total cluster count (TMU count is bound to cluster count)
Cluster enable mask, bit0-15 = cluster 1-16. Clear a bit to isolate a faulted cluster
Reset all clusters: write 1 ONCE (vendor: single send, never repeat)
All clusters HV: write 40215=1,40216=0 for ON; 40215=0,40216=1 for OFF; other combos invalid. Always write as a pair
